label_groups.name: Invoice Header
label_groups.instructions: Extract the top-level invoice metadata printed at the header of the document.

fields.name: Invoice Number
fields.instructions: The unique invoice identifier, usually prefixed with a vendor code (e.g. ACM-2024-00891).

fields.name: Invoice Date
fields.instructions: The date the invoice was issued. Return as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: Due Date
fields.instructions: The payment due date. Return as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: PO Number
fields.instructions: The buyer purchase order number referenced on this invoice.

fields.name: Payment Terms
fields.instructions: Terms such as Net 30, Net 15, or Due on Receipt.

fields.name: Currency
fields.instructions: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g. USD, EUR).

label_groups.name: Vendor Details
label_groups.instructions: Extract the vendor (seller) contact and identification details.

fields.name: Vendor Name
fields.instructions: Legal name of the vendor / supplier company.

fields.name: Vendor Address
fields.instructions: Full mailing address of the vendor including street, city, state, ZIP.

fields.name: Vendor Email
fields.instructions: Billing or accounts-receivable email address of the vendor.

fields.name: Vendor Phone
fields.instructions: Phone number of the vendor.

label_groups.name: Bill To
label_groups.instructions: Extract the buyer / bill-to party name and address.

fields.name: Bill-To Name
fields.instructions: Name of the billing entity or department.

fields.name: Bill-To Address
fields.instructions: Full mailing address of the bill-to party.

label_groups.name: Invoice Totals
label_groups.instructions: Extract the financial summary fields from the totals section.

fields.name: Subtotal
fields.instructions: Sum before tax. Normalise to decimal (e.g. 10,300.00 USD).

fields.name: Tax Rate
fields.instructions: Tax percentage rate applied. Return as a plain number (e.g. 8.5).

fields.name: Tax Amount
fields.instructions: Dollar amount of tax charged.

fields.name: Total Due
fields.instructions: Final amount due including tax. This is the amount to be paid.

label_groups.name: Line Items
label_groups.instructions: Extract each individual product or service line from the invoice table.

fields.name: Description
fields.instructions: Description of the product or service on this line.

fields.name: Quantity
fields.instructions: Number of units for this line item.

fields.name: Unit Price
fields.instructions: Price per unit for this line.

fields.name: Line Total
fields.instructions: Total for this line (qty × unit price).
